description: A repository's .discobox/settings.json: the sources it is worked on with, the features its boxes turn off, and its project layer.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file is checked against, for an editor.

enabled.description: False turns the feature off. Absent leaves it on.

features.description: The box's features by name, each true, false, or an object whose enabled is false to turn it off. Checked, but no feature reads it yet.

filesAdd.description: Files written into the sandbox. A path the harness image or the sandbox already declares is left as it is.

createOnly.description: Leave the file alone when it already exists.

path.description: The file's path, relative to the sandbox user's home directory.

template.description: Render the content against the public sandbox configuration before writing it.

relaunchCommand.description: The command the harness is relaunched with, replacing the harness image's.

runCommand.description: The command the harness runs, replacing the harness image's.

sources.description: The other repositories this one is worked on with, by name: a Git URL with an optional @REF. The checkout beside this repository named the same is used when there is one, and the URL is cloned to where it would have been when there is not.

workingDirectorySubpath.description: The directory beneath the repository the harness starts in.

title: Discobox repository settings
